python3 -I - <<'E'
import csv,json,collections as C
r=list(csv.DictReader(open('labels/experts.csv')))
j={(x['case_id'],x['criterion']):x['label'] for x in map(json.loads,open('labels/judge.jsonl'))}
for crit in ['fast_track_correct','fraud_flags_correct','note_grounded']:
  for rt in['uw-mensah','uw-castillo']:
    rows=[x for x in r if x['criterion']==crit and x['rater']==rt]
    ag=sum(j[(x['case_id'],crit)]==x['label'] for x in rows)
    print(crit,rt,ag,len(rows),'judge fail',sum(j[(x['case_id'],crit)]=='fail' for x in rows))
# pairwise per half for fraud kappa-ish
E
